description: NaKTiO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.81-3.16 Å. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent TiO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent TiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are three shorter (2.33 Å) and two longer (2.36 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ti is bonded to five O atoms to form TiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent TiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-2.02 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, two equivalent Na, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Ti atom.
